craft_notes: Sthāyin: constructed order with proofs. Rows: making then instances. Read aloud: weave then wonders.

lines: But the built cause-work the Lord's will wove, fate-threaded:
hold the fixed first-later show, even beyond, still self-true,
only so — so from yogin's wish, from seed the sprout,
in dream and beyond, pots and the like.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kalpitas tu kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ parameśecchayā niyatiprāṇayā nirmitaḥ sa ca yāvati yadā niyatapaurvāparyāvabhāsanaṃ saty api adhike svarūpānugatam etāvaty eva tena yogīcchāto 'pi aṅkuro bījād api svapnādau ghaṭāder apīti
